title: Lookup-table rows held in memory
description: The plain embeddings plugin: the table kept in memory, rows indexed by id. The reference for file-backed tables; its device form's store() returns a table handle (lookup(ids), close(); any number of tables, NVFP4 rows too, as lookup-table-rows' store() gives them) indexing a table on the device, or with host: true keeping it in registered host memory and gathers a step's rows over the link (no device memory for the table); open() (embeddings:host) reads a table the plan put off the device from the checkpoint's files once into registered host memory, gathered over the link the same way. Either lookup captures in a CUDA graph (rounds:embeddings, and prompts:embeddings: a padded prompt bucket's lookup reads the batch's token ids alone, the padding row 0).

host.description: device form: store() keeps the table in registered host memory, gathered over the link (lookup-table-rows' HostRows), not on the device

host.load: load(table): the lookup table, one [width] row per id (token or hashed n-gram embeddings)
host.rows: rows(ids) -> [row]: the table rows of the ids, in request order

device.store: store(rows, format=None, scales=None, scale=1.0, dtype=None) -> table: a lookup table on the device ([ids][width] of its dtype; format nvfp4: rows the E2M1 codes [ids][width / 2], scales the E4M3 scales [ids][width / 16], scale the global scale, dtype the decoded dtype), returned as a handle with lookup(ids) and close(); a plugin holds any number of tables
device.lookup: lookup(ids) -> rows: the last stored table's row of each id ([tokens] int64 -> [tokens][width])

methods.open: open(source, width, dtype, device) -> a table (lookup(ids), prefetch(ids), close()): the table in host memory or files (source: a CPU tensor of rows, a file path, a list of paths each holding the next rows, or {paths, offsets, rows}); store(rows) also returns one
methods.prefetch: prefetch(ids): host ids known ahead (the next prompt chunk, a round's tokens), read for the last table's lookup

embeddings:host.about: Lookup-table rows kept in host memory or files, staged to the device.
